title: Need advice
author: chatbel
selftext:
I joined this community a week ago and seen the amazing games you guys are creating . Before knowing this sub , I was trying to do a pseudo-idle game , I have the workflow, I asked Claude to do a prototype in HTML with just the gui and see if it’s fun and , it is. But when I told the AI to make a plan to give to Claude code, and using Unity. I think I spent around 10 hours and now it barely did the UI on unity . I feel it’s over complicating and I don’t want to spent millions of tokens and barely got anything functional.

Any advices ? Will be a game destined to phones but suitable for steam also . Unity has that flexibility to export on any of those later . Thanks
